body:
Found in the economy red team (30 Oct). Finishing a designer room gives +1 Decorating level, but it also sets the XP toward the next level back to 0 (js/03-game.js:187, bumpLevel). Any Decorating XP you earned at home is lost. Pet Show 1st place (+2 Pet care levels) and claw level prizes do the same.
Fix: keep the XP when a level is given. Clearly broken, so it is fixed in the next update.

comments.text: Clearly broken game behaviour: project rules say fix, then tell. Recorded as approved for that reason.

Karolis said 'do the rebalance' in the Schedules and economy chat (30 Oct): approved. Built as a code patch (economy-rebalance.patch, build 2026103101) and checked with the quick kit; goes live through a pull request in the next repo chat.

short: Level prizes reset XP to 0; fix keeps it. Built, not live.
source: chat 2026-10-30: Schedules and economy red team 2
title: Bug: finishing a designer room wipes your Decorating progress
